mappings.designName: Billing / Plans + Current Subscription + Checkout + Payment Results (+ Checkout Mobile)

approval.basis: Codex finalized the billing designs; live-inspected 2026-08-24 via MCP across five boards; provider labels updated in-file via MCP 2026-08-24 per ADR-009 (Bank Melli radio → به‌پرداخت ملت on Checkout Desktop+Mobile; design system unchanged). Plans: intro banner #fcebf6 r16 (server-owned prices), period selector pill display-only, plan cards white r16 with ✓ feature rows and «انتخاب پلن/انتخاب‌شده» states, one-off payment notice #fff6e6 (no auto-charge v1). Current Subscription: فعال badge #e9f7f1 + brand stripe, period meta from server, entitlement summary, «تمدید اشتراک» CTA + renewal card + payment history panel. Checkout: order summary (all amounts «مقدار سرور», total box brand, note that browser/callback amounts are ignored, secure note #edf3ff) + provider radios زرین‌پال/به‌پرداخت ملت (Mellat marked as requiring the verified merchant contract) + redirect state note. Payment Results: pending/success/failed/cancelled/already-verified/verification-error cards with idempotency copy.

mappings.notes: Amounts render exactly as received from GET /billing/plans (IRR grouping + ریال only); checkout submits only planCode+providerId; result page polls the workspace-scoped status endpoint because callback query hints alone are never trusted.
